cues.text: Captions make a video easier to follow, even with the sound off.
cues.zh: 字幕让视频即使静音也容易看懂。
cues.line_text: Captions make a video easier to follow, even with the sound off.

cues.text: In this tutorial, I'll add captions to a short clip using Shotcut, a free and open-source video editor.
cues.zh: 本教程用免费开源剪辑软件 Shotcut 给一段短视频加字幕。
cues.line_text: In this tutorial, I'll add captions to a short clip using Shotcut, a free and open-source video editor.

cues.text: We'll import the clip, add captions, check the timing, move them into place, and export.
cues.zh: 步骤：导入、加字幕、检查时间、调整位置、导出。
cues.line_text: We'll import the clip, add captions, check the timing, move them into place, and export.

cues.text: Click Open File, choose your video, and press Enter.
cues.zh: 点击 Open File，选择视频并回车，片段会在播放器中打开。
cues.line_text: Click Open File, choose your video, and press Enter. The clip opens in the player.

cues.text: The clip opens in the player.
cues.line_text: Click Open File, choose your video, and press Enter. The clip opens in the player.

cues.text: Click the plus button in the timeline to add the clip to your project.
cues.zh: 点击时间线上的加号，把片段加入项目。
cues.line_text: Click the plus button in the timeline to add the clip to your project.

cues.text: Next, click Subtitles in the toolbar to open the Subtitles panel.
cues.zh: 然后点击工具栏的 Subtitles，打开字幕面板。
cues.line_text: Next, click Subtitles in the toolbar to open the Subtitles panel.

cues.text: Click the plus button at the top to create a new subtitle track.
cues.zh: 点击顶部加号新建字幕轨，命名、语言选英语，点 OK。
cues.line_text: Click the plus button at the top to create a new subtitle track. Name it, set the language to English, and click OK.

cues.text: Name it, set the language to English, and click OK.
cues.line_text: Click the plus button at the top to create a new subtitle track. Name it, set the language to English, and click OK.

cues.text: Now move the playhead to where the first line starts.
cues.zh: 把播放头移到第一句开始处，点击添加，在 Current 框输入字幕。
cues.line_text: Now move the playhead to where the first line starts. Click Add, and type the caption into the Current box.

cues.text: Click Add, and type the caption into the Current box.
cues.line_text: Now move the playhead to where the first line starts. Click Add, and type the caption into the Current box.

cues.text: To end the caption, move the playhead to the end of the line, and click Set End.
cues.zh: 把播放头移到这句结尾，点击 Set End 设置结束点。
cues.line_text: To end the caption, move the playhead to the end of the line, and click Set End.

cues.text: Repeat the same steps for the next two lines.
cues.zh: 后两句重复同样的步骤。
cues.line_text: Repeat the same steps for the next two lines.

cues.text: To show the captions on the video, click the Burn In button.
cues.zh: 点击 Burn In 按钮，会在输出上添加字幕烧录滤镜，字幕就显示在画面上。
cues.line_text: To show the captions on the video, click the Burn In button. It adds a Subtitle Burn In filter to the output.

cues.text: It adds a Subtitle Burn In filter to the output.
cues.line_text: To show the captions on the video, click the Burn In button. It adds a Subtitle Burn In filter to the output.

cues.text: Play it back from the start, and check that each caption matches what you hear.
cues.zh: 从头播放，检查每条字幕是否和声音对应。
cues.line_text: Play it back from the start, and check that each caption matches what you hear.

cues.text: If a caption needs to start earlier, move the playhead, select the caption, and click Set Start.
cues.zh: 如果字幕需要提前开始，先移动播放头，再选中字幕，点击 Set Start。
cues.line_text: If a caption needs to start earlier, move the playhead, select the caption, and click Set Start.

cues.text: Now let's reposition the captions.
cues.zh: 接下来调整字幕位置。在滤镜面板里，字幕烧录滤镜控制位置和样式。
cues.line_text: Now let's reposition the captions. In the Filters panel, the Subtitle Burn In filter controls position and style.

cues.text: In the Filters panel, the Subtitle Burn In filter controls position and style.
cues.line_text: Now let's reposition the captions. In the Filters panel, the Subtitle Burn In filter controls position and style.

cues.text: I move them up a little by changing the vertical position.
cues.zh: 修改垂直位置把字幕上移一点，再加粗描边，让文字更清晰。
cues.line_text: I move them up a little by changing the vertical position. Then I make the outline thicker, so the text stays readable.

cues.text: Then I make the outline thicker, so the text stays readable.
cues.line_text: I move them up a little by changing the vertical position. Then I make the outline thicker, so the text stays readable.

cues.text: When it looks right, click Export.
cues.zh: 满意后点击 Export，保持 Default 预设（H.264 MP4），点击导出。
cues.line_text: When it looks right, click Export. Keep the Default preset, which makes an H.264 MP4 file, and click Export Video and Audio.

cues.text: Keep the Default preset, which makes an H.264 MP4 file, and click Export Video and Audio.
cues.line_text: When it looks right, click Export. Keep the Default preset, which makes an H.264 MP4 file, and click Export Video and Audio.

cues.text: Type a file name and press Enter.
cues.zh: 输入文件名并回车，Shotcut 在任务面板中渲染。
cues.line_text: Type a file name and press Enter. Shotcut renders the video in the Jobs panel.

cues.text: Shotcut renders the video in the Jobs panel.
cues.line_text: Type a file name and press Enter. Shotcut renders the video in the Jobs panel.

cues.text: When the job is done, open the new file to check the result.
cues.zh: 任务完成后打开新文件检查，字幕已经烧进视频里了。
cues.line_text: When the job is done, open the new file to check the result. The captions are now part of the video.

cues.text: The captions are now part of the video.
cues.line_text: When the job is done, open the new file to check the result. The captions are now part of the video.

cues.text: That's the whole process: import, add captions, check the timing, reposition, and export.
cues.zh: 完整流程：导入、加字幕、检查时间、调整位置、导出。
cues.line_text: That's the whole process: import, add captions, check the timing, reposition, and export.

cues.text: Thanks for watching.
cues.zh: 感谢观看。
cues.line_text: Thanks for watching.
